_about: Every user-visible setting of the app, by category and card, from DiPlayActivity.kt (allSettingsSections) and values/*.xml. One source for the web prototype (catalog.js) and the Android preview (mobile/src/debug/assets/openplay_settings.json); regenerate both with build_catalog.py. Row kinds: toggle, picker, number, slider, text, button, link, note. 'when' shows a row only while other settings match; 'requires' is the hardware or access a row depends on in the real app (shown as a caption). 'reconnect': now | confirm | next.

rows.label: Connect when OpenPlay opens
rows.hint: Use the default connection mode and selected iPhone when OpenPlay opens.

rows.label: Connect when the selected iPhone reconnects
rows.hint: After the car wakes, start wireless CarPlay when the selected iPhone connects over Bluetooth. Some head units restrict background launches.

rows.label: Open after the car starts
rows.hint: Availability depends on your head unit's startup settings.

rows.label: Auto-confirm USB permission
rows.hint: Accept the Android USB prompt when an iPhone is connected by cable. Requires the accessibility service.

rows.label: Boot auto-start · ADB repair (experimental)
rows.toast: Asks the head unit to exempt OpenPlay from background limits

rows.text: Some firmwares block third-party boot receivers. This asks the head unit, over its own ADB link, to exempt OpenPlay from background limits. One-time; re-run after a firmware update.

rows.label: iPhone charging
rows.hint: How much charging current OpenPlay offers the iPhone over USB. Applies at the next USB connection.

rows.label: Automatically turn on the car hotspot
rows.hint: Turns on the saved car hotspot when OpenPlay opens and before a wireless connection. Needs Android's "Modify system settings" access; ADB is not required.

rows.text: "Modify system settings" access is not allowed yet. Allow it so OpenPlay can turn on the hotspot.

rows.label: Automatically turn on the car hotspot
rows.hint: Starts the saved car hotspot when OpenPlay opens. Turning this on requests the required permissions through ADB; allow the prompt on the car screen.

rows.text: ADB access ready.
USB, usage and overlay permissions verified ✓
Nearby devices connects your iPhone. Microphone enables Siri and calls. Older Android versions also require Location for wireless setup. USB mode may ask for a local VPN connection.

categories.title: Display
categories.subtitle: Appearance, full screen, resolution and frame rate

rows.text: Auto follows the saved CarPlay day/night setting; while CarPlay is open, it follows the live result. Light and Dark stay fixed and do not require a reconnect.
Save and return to CarPlay to apply. Even if you select Always day, CarPlay may still appear dark at night when its own appearance is Automatic.
Uses the threshold and delay below. Without a light sensor, it follows Android.

rows.label: Brightness threshold
rows.hint: Below the threshold selects night; at or above it selects day.

rows.label: Transition delay
rows.hint: Zero switches immediately.

rows.text: Uses the head unit's local time. Set different start and end times; overnight ranges are supported.

rows.label: CarPlay size
rows.hint: Changes the size of CarPlay icons and text. Applying a size reconnects CarPlay.

rows.label: Resolution
rows.hint: 30–160 percent. Applying reconnects CarPlay.

rows.label: CarPlay dock
rows.hint: Between Driver's side and Bottom it moves at once; Automatic leaves it to the iPhone and applies after a reconnect.

rows.label: Hide the status bar
rows.hint: Hide the selected system bar in OpenPlay and CarPlay.

rows.label: Adapt multi-window resolution
rows.hint: Reconnect CarPlay to adapt stream resolution to multi-window or picture-in-picture. Leave off for instant GPU scaling.

rows.label: Interface size
rows.hint: Size of text and controls on OpenPlay's own screens. CarPlay is not affected.

rows.label: Force full Settings layout
rows.hint: Use the full Settings layout with a category sidebar in landscape.

rows.text: 0 = automatic routing. Values 1–20 select legacy audio stream IDs, including vendor-specific outputs. Tap a value to preview it. Changes apply on reconnect.
Reduce CarPlay navigation guidance without changing music or call volume. Applies immediately.

rows.label: Calls on the loudspeaker
rows.hint: For an Android phone or tablet used as the head unit. Leave off on a car head unit. Applies from the next call.

categories.title: Navigation
categories.subtitle: Location reporting and supported dashboard guidance

rows.label: Report location to iPhone
rows.hint: Sends precise Android location as CarPlay GPS data when the iPhone requests it.

rows.text: Changing this setting reconnects an active CarPlay session.

rows.label: Navigation on HUD and dashboard
rows.hint: Show phone navigation arrows, distance and street names on supported BYD displays.

rows.label: Guidance in the FCE cluster (experimental)
rows.hint: Shows CarPlay arrows and the next-turn distance in the cluster's navigation view. Tested on one car only.

rows.label: Song or lyrics on the HUD
rows.hint: Show the title or lyrics while no navigation guidance is active.

rows.label: Song on the dashboard
rows.hint: The CarPlay song title and artist appear in the cluster's music card. Applies at once.

rows.label: Song only when it changes
rows.hint: A new song shows on the dashboard for 5 seconds, then the card is emptied.

rows.label: CarPlay call, Siri and media keys (experimental)
rows.hint: The phone key answers incoming CarPlay calls. Support must be checked on your vehicle and firmware.

rows.label: CarPlay calls on the dashboard
rows.hint: Incoming and ongoing CarPlay calls show the caller on the cluster. Applies at once.

categories.title: Vehicle
categories.subtitle: Driving side, wheel keys, car button and CarPlay gestures

rows.text: Pick a finger count your head unit does not already use. BYD takes three-finger swipe-down for its air-conditioning panel.

rows.label: Right-hand drive
rows.hint: Place CarPlay's controls closer to the driver.

rows.label: Siri key on the wheel
rows.hint: Opens Siri with a wheel key you choose while CarPlay is on the screen.

rows.label: Double press for Siri
rows.hint: A single press keeps the car's action. Press twice within the interval for Siri.

rows.label: Key for Siri: none · tap to change
rows.toast: Press the wheel key for Siri now

rows.label: Play/pause key on the wheel
rows.hint: Assign any steering-wheel or keyboard key to toggle CarPlay music.

rows.label: Key for Play/pause: none · tap to change
rows.toast: Press the wheel key for Play/pause now

rows.label: Siri on long press only
rows.hint: Only a long press of the wheel's voice button opens Siri.

rows.label: External controller (experimental)
rows.hint: Keys from a paired Bluetooth keyboard, remote or rotary controller move and select in CarPlay. Applies at once.

rows.text: Wheel key service: off. Turn it on over ADB or in accessibility settings.

rows.label: Turn on the wheel key service · ADB
rows.toast: Enables the wheel key service over ADB

rows.label: Zoom the dashboard map with the wheel
rows.hint: BYD's custom key switches the volume keys between volume and dashboard map zoom.

rows.label: CarPlay joystick on the wheel
rows.hint: BYD's media key turns a joystick for CarPlay's centre screen on and off.

rows.label: Joystick turns off by itself
rows.hint: After 15 seconds without a press, and when a route starts, the keys go back to music and volume.

rows.label: Key for select: none · tap to change
rows.toast: Press the wheel key for select now

rows.text: CarPlay shows this icon and name in its app list. Tap it to return to the car's own screen. Changes apply the next time CarPlay connects.
Vehicle and dashboard features vary by model and firmware. Review them in Advanced settings before enabling experimental controls.
System default follows the device language.

categories.subtitle: Save a local report when troubleshooting a connection

rows.label: Get the report on a phone
rows.toast: Shows a QR code for a phone on the same network

rows.text: Reports save to Downloads/OpenPlay. Nothing is sent automatically. Protocol payloads and credentials are excluded.

rows.label: FPS counter
rows.hint: Shows frames per second, frames received and decode time in the top-right corner of CarPlay.

categories.title: Advanced
categories.subtitle: Experimental and vehicle-specific controls for experienced users

cards.text: Change with care. These features can depend on vehicle firmware, ADB access, or experimental CarPlay behavior. Everyday settings are in the categories above.

rows.label: Harman head-unit full screen (experimental)
rows.hint: Let CarPlay occupy the OEM side-panel area on supported Harman head units. Applies when the CarPlay window next opens.

rows.label: CarPlay in the head unit's split screen
rows.hint: CarPlay redraws for the split-screen window instead of shrinking with black bars. Applies at the next connection.

rows.label: Turn CarPlay with the screen without reconnecting
rows.hint: For head units whose screen turns. CarPlay gets a square picture. Applies at the next connection.

rows.label: Side panel next to CarPlay (experimental)
rows.hint: CarPlay can move to two thirds of the screen while OpenPlay shows a panel in the rest. Applies at the next connection.

rows.label: Hide BYD call popup (experimental)
rows.hint: Hides the native call popup while CarPlay is in the foreground.

rows.label: Efficient video
rows.hint: Use HEVC. Leave off for the widest head-unit compatibility.

rows.label: MTK decoder low latency (experimental)
rows.hint: Uses a dedicated MTK low-latency decoder. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.

rows.label: Smooth video (experimental)
rows.hint: Shows each frame at the time the iPhone stamped on it plus a short delay. Picture adjustments do not apply. Reconnects CarPlay.

rows.label: Direct video output (experimental)
rows.hint: Sends the picture straight to the compositor. Can lower the delay by about one screen refresh. Reconnects CarPlay.

rows.label: Low-latency decoding (experimental)
rows.hint: Asks Qualcomm decoders to output each frame as soon as it is decoded. Turn it off if the picture shows artifacts.

rows.label: Call echo cancellation (experimental)
rows.hint: Tries to reduce speaker echo during CarPlay calls.

rows.label: Clearer call voices (experimental)
rows.hint: Cuts bass from CarPlay call audio.

rows.label: Car phone audio for CarPlay calls (experimental)
rows.hint: Holds a Telecom call so the car switches to its phone audio state. Applies at the next call.

rows.label: Car phone audio for VoIP calls in other apps (experimental)
rows.hint: The same while WhatsApp, Telegram or Zoom is in a call. Also turns on the wheel-key accessibility service.

rows.label: Disable media-key audio focus (experimental)
rows.hint: Stops OpenPlay from requesting media audio focus while CarPlay music is active.

rows.label: Audio focus
rows.hint: CarPlay media claims audio focus. If sound disappears while enabled, turn it off.

rows.label: Mute media on temporary focus loss
rows.hint: Mute media during Android audio interruptions, including calls.

rows.label: Advanced audio channel mapping
rows.hint: Use usage / content-type routing instead of stream type.

rows.label: Buffered music (experimental)
rows.hint: Apps such as Apple Music send up to about two minutes of music ahead. Reconnects CarPlay.

rows.label: Clearer navigation voice over USB (experimental)
rows.hint: Stops offering 8 and 16 kHz for navigation prompts over USB. If prompts go silent, turn it off.

rows.label: CarPlay audio over the car's Bluetooth (experimental)
rows.hint: Music, navigation and calls go over the iPhone's Bluetooth connection with the car. Reconnects CarPlay.

rows.label: Wheel volume during navigation guidance (experimental)
rows.hint: During spoken guidance, volume keys adjust the navigation audio stream. Tested on a Tang platform-21 head unit.

rows.text: Allow the wheel key accessibility service in Android settings, or use the ADB authorization button.

rows.label: Turn on the wheel key service · ADB
rows.toast: Enables the wheel key service over ADB

rows.label: Car's own music rhythm
rows.hint: While CarPlay music plays, the car's own ambient-light rhythm runs with the colours set in the car's menu.

rows.label: Send music data to the car's rhythm (older head units)
rows.hint: For head units (such as a 2023 Han) where the rhythm starts but stays dark. Only with the car's own rhythm on.

rows.label: Home-screen bubble (experimental)
rows.hint: Shows the OpenPlay icon as a bubble over the home screen: tap it to come back to CarPlay and drag it anywhere. Needs "display over other apps".

rows.text: Draw over other apps: allowed

rows.label: DiLink 4 cluster video via ADB (experimental)
rows.hint: Launch the map directly on the verified cluster display through internal ADB.

rows.label: Platform 21 cluster task (experimental)
rows.hint: For the controller-21 adaptation. Applying reconnects CarPlay. Needs a parked-car test.

rows.label: Hide the car's own cluster map
CarPlay map on dashboard (experimental)
rows.hint: Shows the iPhone's map on the dashboard. Choose Small or Full screen navi in the dashboard's steering-wheel menu.

rows.label: Cluster speedometer (experimental)
rows.hint: Shows vehicle speed through authorized ADB. Changes apply immediately.

rows.label: Music on cluster (experimental)
rows.hint: Show a square album cover over the cluster map. Requires cluster projection and iPhone metadata.

rows.label: Dashboard map on the centre screen
rows.hint: While OpenPlay is in the background, the dashboard map also shows as a card on the home screen. Needs permission to draw over other apps.

rows.label: Keep the home-screen map in sync with the dashboard
Hide floating card over non-home apps
rows.hint: Hides the card in music players, reverse camera and settings, and restores it on the launcher.

rows.label: Share the live map with other launchers
rows.hint: Launchers that support OpenPlay can show the live dashboard map inside their own home screen.

rows.label: Follow instrument theme and map card
rows.hint: Show the side map only when its card is open, and switch to the full map in Map theme.

rows.label: Reset cluster safe area
rows.toast: Safe area reset. Applies at the next connection

rows.label: Reset car marker to centre
rows.toast: Car marker reset. Applies at the next connection

rows.text: Default is three steps (30 %) right of centre. Adjust to wherever the small window sits on your cluster.

rows.label: Dashboard map only in Small and Full navi
rows.hint: OpenPlay reads the navi mode you pick on the steering wheel.

rows.label: Advanced vehicle data
rows.hint: Battery, wheel speed, parked video and Bluetooth pause, through ADB. Nothing is written to the car.

rows.text: An independent CarPlay receiver for Android head units, forked from DiPlay. It is not an Apple-certified product.

rows.label: Check for updates in the background
rows.hint: Once a day, OpenPlay checks GitHub for a new version. It never downloads without your tap.

rows.toast: Shows a QR code for a phone on the same network

rows.text: Show a QR code so a phone browser on the same network can export or import settings. The service stops when you leave the page.

ambient.title: Ambient light settings
ambient.note: Configure while parked. Experimental support for selected BYD lamp interfaces. Level 0 means the lowest OEM level, not power off.

rows.label: Enable ambient light control
rows.hint: Turning this off attempts to restore the original lamp colors, brightness and area. Existing ADB authorization is required.

rows.label: Follow music
rows.hint: When playing, follow the music, or use fixed colors and brightness if off.

rows.label: Follow album cover
rows.hint: Use the cover's color or nearby available car colors.

vehicleData.title: Advanced vehicle data
vehicleData.note: Choose the default DiLink 5.0 data path or detect fields on a legacy head unit. Nothing is written to the car.

rows.text: OpenPlay is not approved yet. Tap Check ADB access, then allow the prompt on the car screen.

rows.label: Pause car Bluetooth during CarPlay · needs ADB
rows.hint: The phone keeps its hands-free link to the car. Pairing is never touched.

rows.label: Car battery for the iPhone
rows.hint: OpenPlay tells the iPhone the car's charge and range, so Apple Maps can warn about a low charge.

rows.label: Wheel speed for tunnels
rows.hint: With Report location on, also sends the car's wheel speed and gear.

rows.label: Video while parked
rows.hint: iOS 27: a video you send to CarPlay plays on the car screen while the car is in P.
